name_en: Shou-Wu Zhang formula (exact formula identification open)
literal_source_claim: A higher-dimensional generalization of the Gross-Zagier formula.
domain_and_universes: Open: the source must fix the modular or automorphic datum, imaginary quadratic field, Kuga-Sato or Shimura variety, coefficient field, cycle, and height and L-function codomains.
conclusion: Open: no normalized equality between a height pairing and an L-function derivative is stated in the repository source.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not frozen. Vanishing signs, non-Heegner discriminants, bad primes, imprimitive Euler factors, zero cycles, and normalization-dependent constants must come from the selected source.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical logic and choice policy remain open until the proposition and arithmetic-geometric interfaces are frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel and pinned mathlib are the intended base; toolchain fingerprint, exact imports, and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No numerical computation, oracle, certificate, or experimental L-value is credited; expected objects are largely noncomputable
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source selection, formula or normalization, hypotheses, Lean target, dependency pin, assurance profile, or validator change; independent reviewers and review due date remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. No unique source equation or canonical Lean target is selected. No H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
